description: Details required by Conditions 4 (Protection of trees during construction), 12 (Construction Traffic Management Plan (CTMP)), 14 (Small Scale Dust Management Plan (SSDMP), 15 (Professional management of engineering works), 19 (Part 1 only) (Small-scale ground gas and vapour protection - Preliminary Risk Assessment (PRA)) of planning permission PP/25/01598 (Excavation under the footprint of the house and part of the front and rear gardens to form a single basement level, and lowering of the lower ground floor slab to improve floor-to-ceiling height at this level; rebuilding of the 1960s two-storey rear addition at lower ground and upper ground floor levels (including an increase in width at the upper ground floor level); construction of a single-storey side addition at lower ground floor; enlargement of the rear and side dormer windows and replacement of existing dormers on the front roof slope; elevational alterations; erection of a closet wing extension and new openings at first floor level; and provision of an upper ground floor terrace)
